```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
sdrf <- read.delim("~/hpchome/ftp/ftp.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/fire/E-MTAB-/303/E-MTAB-12303/Files/E-MTAB-12303.sdrf.txt", sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

colnames(sdrf) <- make.unique(colnames(sdrf))

# Build mapping: Source Name -> tar.gz files
mapping <- sdrf %>%
  select(`Source Name`, starts_with("Derived Array Data File")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -`Source Name`,
    names_to = "file_col",
    values_to = "tar_file"
  ) %>%
  filter(grepl("\\.tar\\.gz$", tar_file)) %>%
  distinct(`Source Name`, tar_file)

# Extract patient/sample prefix (everything before first "_")
mapping <- mapping %>%
  mutate(Patient = str_extract(`Source Name`, "^[^_]+")) %>%
  group_by(Patient) %>%
  summarise(tar_files = list(unique(tar_file)), .groups = "drop")

# Show result
mapping
```


```{r}
name_map <- mapping %>%
  unnest(tar_files) %>%
  mutate(tar_files = gsub("\\.tar\\.gz$", "", tar_files))

name_map <- as.data.frame(name_map)

name_map <- subset(name_map, tar_files %in% names(so.list))

name_map <- name_map %>%
  group_by(Patient) %>%
  mutate(
    is_wsss = grepl("^WSSS", tar_files),
    gex_index = ifelse(is_wsss, row_number(), NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


name_map <- name_map %>%
  mutate(
    final_name = case_when(
      # WSSS samples -> CTCLx_GEX_#
      is_wsss ~ paste0(Patient, "_GEX_", gex_index),
      # Already has GEX in the name -> keep
      str_detect(tar_files, "GEX_") ~ tar_files,
      # Everything else: default to patient
      TRUE ~ Patient
    )
  )
```





```{r}
list <- list.dirs("~/hpchome/ftp/ftp.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/fire/E-MTAB-/303/E-MTAB-12303/Files", recursive = F, full.names = F)
so.list <- list()
for (i in seq_along(list)) {
  tmp <- list[i]
  path <- paste0("~/hpchome/ftp/ftp.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/fire/E-MTAB-/303/E-MTAB-12303/Files/", 
                 tmp, "/output/Gene/filtered")
  
  if (dir.exists(path)) {
    message("Processing: ", tmp)
    data <- Read10X(data.dir = path)
    data <- update_gene_names_sparse(data)
    so <- CreateSeuratObject(data, min.cells = 3, min.features = 300, project = tmp)
    so.list[[tmp]] <- so   # store by sample name
  } else {
    message("Skipping: ", tmp, " (directory not found)")
  }
}

names(so.list)

names(so.list) <- name_map$final_name[match(names(so.list), name_map$tar_files)]

so.list <- lapply(so.list, function(x) {
  # remove sample prefix up to the last underscore, then remove trailing -digits
  x@meta.data$barcode <- colnames(x)
  return(x)
})
```

```{r}
vdj_map <- mapping %>%
  unnest(tar_files) %>%
  mutate(tar_files = gsub("\\.tar\\.gz$", "", tar_files)) %>%
  filter(grepl("VDJ|WSSS", tar_files))   # keep only VDJ or WSSS entries

vdj_map <- as.data.frame(vdj_map)

vdj_map <- subset(vdj_map, tar_files %in% names(vdj.list))

vdj_map <- vdj_map %>%
  group_by(Patient) %>%
  mutate(
    is_wsss = grepl("^WSSS", tar_files),
    vdj_index = ifelse(is_wsss, row_number(), NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

vdj_map <- vdj_map %>%
  mutate(
    final_name = case_when(
      # WSSS samples → CTCLx_VDJ_#
      is_wsss ~ paste0(Patient, "_VDJ_", vdj_index),
      # Already has VDJ in the name → keep
      str_detect(tar_files, "VDJ_") ~ tar_files,
      TRUE ~ Patient
    )
  )

names(vdj.list) <- vdj_map$final_name[match(names(vdj.list), vdj_map$tar_files)]

```



```{r}
# GEX barcodes
gex_barcodes <- lapply(so.list, colnames)

# VDJ barcodes (strip the "-1" suffix for matching)
vdj_barcodes <- lapply(vdj.list, function(x) gsub("-1$", "", x$barcode))


overlap_matrix <- sapply(vdj_barcodes, function(v_bcs) {
  sapply(gex_barcodes, function(g_bcs) length(intersect(v_bcs, g_bcs)))
})

# For each VDJ, find the best-matching GEX
best_match <- apply(overlap_matrix, 2, function(x) names(x)[which.max(x)])
best_match

vdj.list.save <- vdj.list
#vdj.list <- vdj.list.save
names(vdj.list) <- best_match[colnames(overlap_matrix)]

combined.TCR <- combineTCR(
  vdj.list,
  samples = names(vdj.list),
  removeNA = FALSE,
  removeMulti = FALSE,
  filterMulti = TRUE
)


combined.TCR <- lapply(combined.TCR, function(df) {
  # remove sample prefix up to the last underscore, then remove trailing -digits
  df$barcode <- sub("-\\d+$", "", sub("^.*_", "", df$barcode))
  df
})


valid_samples <- names(vdj.list)
screp.list <- list()
for(i in seq_along(valid_samples)){
  tmp <- valid_samples[i]
  screp.list[[tmp]] <- combineExpression(combined.TCR[tmp], so.list[[tmp]], chain = "both", cloneCall = "gene", proportion = TRUE)
}

missing.tcr <- setdiff(names(so.list), names(screp.list))
missingtcr.list <- so.list[missing.tcr]

th2.list <- c(screp.list, missingtcr.list)
saveRDS(th2.list, file = "~/hpchome/th2.list2.rds")
```
